name: Vega Group
subject: EUR 1.5M seed - AI-assisted radiology platform (DACH fit)
body:
Hi Vega Group team,

Given Vega Group's focus on Radiology AI and your work with companies like RehabLoop, I wanted to share an Austrian MedTech startup we believe fits your thesis: an AI-assisted radiology platform automating scan analysis and structured reporting, live in 3 hospital pilots with a CE/MDR pathway underway.

We are raising a EUR 1.5M seed round with tickets from EUR 250K, and your Seed sweet spot matches where we are. Happy to share the deck and pilot data if useful.

Best regards,
Om Rana
